## Suggested next step

The seeded pages are a starting shape, not a curriculum. The wiki gets useful when it
holds phrases **you actually heard** — so the next move is to capture one. Next time
something lands in conversation and you don't quite have it, type the characters here and
it gets filed.

If you want a first target from what's already seeded: [[final-particles]] 囉 and 喇. They
cost nothing to add to sentences you already say, and they do more for not sounding
textbook than any amount of new vocabulary.
